fact: CBOS Circular 7/2026 of 31 March 2026 sets binding minimum USSD rules and cites the Payment Systems Regulation 2013 and the 2020 mobile-payment financial institutions licensing regulation as its basis.
system: Payment Systems Regulation 2013; Mobile Payment Financial Institutions Regulation 2020

fact: The circular lets mobile-payment financial institutions and electronic payment providers licensed by the central bank offer USSD financial services alongside banks, on production of their CBOS licence certificate.

The Regulation on Licensing and Organising Mobile Payment Financial Institutions 2020, issued under article 60(1) of the Banking Business Organisation Act 2004 (amended 2014), took effect on signature; the CBOS board approved it on 28 December 2020.
The 2020 regulation has the central bank licence companies, not banks, to run mobile payment and open e-money wallet accounts, with a rule that their names may not include 'bank'.
